title: KSC-06-S-00207 — STS-115 Atlantis external tank camera
contents: Onboard camera on the Space Shuttle external tank during Atlantis' STS-115 launch: orbiter belly and exhaust plume, solid rocket booster separation flash (~45 s into the cut), climbing through the darkening sky until the view of Earth's limb near orbit. Low-res (800x450) original.
